notes.title: FEEL the horror when exploring the Barclay Mansion
notes.content:
Experience horror even more real in [b]Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife[/b], now natively compatible with [b]bHaptics TactSuit and Tactosy for arms![/b]

Here are some of the implementations that will challenge your bravery:
[list]
[i][*] [b]Goosebumps:[/b] Experience the hair raising on your body as you are being noticed by a Spectre
[*] [b]Heartbeats:[/b] Your heart beats harder when you are being chased by a Spectre, and when using 'Sharpened Senses' to find your way around
[*] [b]Damage:[/b] Feel the impact when taking hits by an enemy or walking through portals
[*] [b]Arm vibration:[/b] When using 'Wraithgrasp' to lift heavy objects, your arms vibrate from the accumulated power
[*] [b]Misc. additional haptics support[/b][/i][/list]
Check out this video for a showcase of some of the haptics features:

[previewyoutube=qC9jt9vu99Q;full][/previewyoutube]
In addition to the bHaptics support, we have also made the following updates/fixes to the game in Steam:
[list]
[*] Added new sprint inputs for Knuckles
    - Double-tap Left stick forward
    - Press Right Trackpad
[*] WMR: Fixed issues with sprint input to be more reliable
[/list]
See you in the Afterlife!

notes.title: Afterlife Community Items now available!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that we have enabled [b]Steam Community Items[/b] for Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife!

Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Sets of cards can be turned into game badges and tradable Steam community items. By crafting badges you'll receive random rewards with Afterlife related items. This includes [b]thrilling profile backgrounds[/b] and [b]haunting emoticons[/b].

You can read more about how Steam Trading Cards work [url=https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/]here.[/url]

Hope you like them, and see you all in the world beyond the Shroud!
/The team at Fast Travel Games

notes.title: Grip improvement for Valve Index players
notes.content:
Some Valve Index players have reported issues with grabbing and holding objects - we have now made an improvement to this that should lead to a much more enjoyable experience:
[list]
[*] We have decreased the sensitivity on the grip to reduce the amount of pressure needed to grab and hold objects.
[*] We have also resolved an issue where players could fall outside of the mansion through a whole in the wall(!!!)
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who provided us feedback so far, hopefully you will now enjoy your experience as a Wraith in the Afterlife even more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38624529/5a9563ffb4e8b5445932ee3bbf17e3e64a161a75.png[/img]

notes.title: New content & improvements in the SteamVR version
notes.content:
Today, the doors to the Afterlife opens on SteamVR! To celebrate this, we have added in some [b]additional content & improvements[/b] in the game from the very start. See full list below for what is going into the SteamVR version at launch today at 9am PT/6pm CEST, and make sure to claim the game early with the [b]10% launch discount![/b]

[b]NEW CONTENT![/b]

[list]
[*] 10 new collectibles have been added, giving additional context to some of the characters and the story.
[/list]
[b]GENERAL FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Addendum as a new achievement for finding all new collectibles
[*] Fixed issue where the doors wouldn’t lock if the Player dies after entering the West Wing corridor for the first time in Chapter 7
[*] Fixed issue where players that have placed the gas key in Chapter 7 and then left before placing the contract can’t get the contract on return
[*] Game completion rate now displayed when finishing the game
[*] All languages now display correctly in the language selection menu
[*] Lighting issue in one of the Guest House bathroom fixed
[*] Fixed several issues with the valve handle in the wine cellar related to loading//going to the Memory Palace
[*] Fixed bugs that caused inconsistencies when using or adding the valve to the wall a second time, after coming back from Memory Palace
[*] Wraithgrasp tutorial voice over in Wine Cellar was missing second half of its subtitles
[*] Alan’s scripts can now be correctly viewed in Memory Palace after having been placed on the table in the Pool House
[*] Moved a glass bottle slightly to avoid it breaking when trying to use Grab on it
[*] Adjusted triggers for a Chapter 7 event, so that the event and objectives triggers in the right order and at the right time
[*] Fixed an issue that could disable Sharpened Senses after dying while using it
[*] Fixed an issue so the dark fog of the BW encounter doesn’t appear after the encounter has finished
[*] Fixed so that the right Sharpened Senses target is activated when NOT picking up the time storm compass, save/quit and then load again
[*] Fixed so that the Chapter 1 Hanged Man music doesn’t linger for various reasons anymore
[*] Making sure collectibles stop resetting outside of streamed in area
[*] Fixed so that the Shadow is not shown in the wrong place when loading a save game during Chapter 1 in the Seance Room
[*] Shortened the time before memory palace tutorial appears, to make it easier for players to see it
[*] PCVR Only: Added tab in Settings menu for Video Quality
[/list]
[b]SPECTRE FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the risk of Spectres getting stuck in walk-through-door animation loop
[*] Spectres align better when they want to interact with something in the world
[*] Spectres now win over Players when having a tug-of-war for door handles, which was always the intention.
[*] Fixed issue with Spectres’ peripheral vision, where they sometimes spotted the player when they shouldn’t or vice versa.
[*] The branches in the Garden did not provide enough cover for the Player. This is now fixed.
[*] Spectres could continue rotating towards the Player while they’re Stunned. They shouldn’t do this, and won’t anymore.
[*] Fixed issue where navmesh would be generated in locations it wasn’t supposed to, and the created problems for the AI
[/list]
[b][i]The Wall Street Wiz Kid:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Wall Street Wiz Kid would sometimes move sideways through doors
[*] Decreased chance of Wall Street Wiz Kid opening the closet where the player is hiding, unless he knows the player is there
[*] Fixed so that Wall Street Wiz Kid properly plays the correct animation when stunned
[*] Fixed several issues with Wall Street Wiz Kid in the chapter 6 encounter
[*] Fixed issue where Wall Street Wiz Kid would sometimes spawn/unspawn in front of the player
[/list]
[i][b]The Sad Cinematographer:[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the Sad Cinematographer would sometimes take a long walk around the garden gazebo
[*] Fixed issue where the Sad Cinematographer would sometimes unlock doors she wasn’t supposed to
[/list]

notes.title: A first look at 'the Shadow'
notes.content:
This Spring, we are releasing [b]Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife.[/b], a VR horror game set in the World of Darkness.

Today, we are revealing the in-game companion and narrator called ‘[b]the Shadow[/b]’; a manifestation of the main character Ed Miller’s dark subconscious who is also your guide in the game as you return to the Barclay Mansion - now as a ghost - to find out the reason behind your death as well as the mystery of the mansion itself.

[url=https://youtu.be/-P_Md_5NnGY]Here is a video[/url] from the game with an early look at the Shadow - we suggest you watch it with headphones on and volume turned up!

If you are interested in reading more about the role of the Shadow, Oculus has just published [url=https://www.oculus.com/blog/introducing-the-shadow-behind-the-scenes-of-wraith-the-oblivion-afterlife/]this new blog post[/url] from our creative director.

We also just launched our [url=https://discord.gg/2dFhAgP2vY]official Discord[/url], if you would like to connect with us.

Make sure to Wishlist the game today and get ready for some chills down your spine in just a few months!
